title.zh: 更新公告、系统回归与代码回放优化
title.en: Release announcements, system regression and code replay improvements

added.zh: 每次升级后显示当前版本公告，提供「查看详情」和「已读」。详情分新增功能、体验优化、问题修复和更新说明，支持中英切换。
added.en: Show an announcement after each upgrade, with View details and Mark as read. Details group new features, improvements, fixes and update notes in Chinese and English.

added.zh: 新增本地 HTTP 检查工具，核对入口资源、页面构建一致性和 51 个受保护接口的匿名访问边界。
added.en: Add a read-only localhost HTTP check for entry assets, consistent page builds and anonymous access to 51 protected endpoints.

fixed.zh: 执行记录刷新会取消过期请求，避免较晚返回的旧列表覆盖最新结果；断网重试保留已有记录。
fixed.en: History refresh cancels superseded requests, prevents stale responses from replacing current results, and keeps existing records during offline retries.

fixed.zh: 多页面同时点击公告已读时合并为同一条记录，避免重复写入报错。
fixed.en: Concurrent acknowledgements from multiple pages share one read receipt instead of failing on duplicate writes.

improved.zh: 公告已读状态按账号和版本保存，跨浏览器同步；查看详情不自动标记已读，点击已读后立即移除提醒。弹出卡片约五秒收起，鼠标悬停或键盘聚焦时暂停，未读公告仍可从通知中心打开。
improved.en: Save read receipts per account and version across browsers. Viewing details does not mark the announcement read; a confirmed receipt clears its badge immediately. Cards collapse after about five seconds, pause on hover or focus, and remain in the notification center until read.

improved.zh: 首页按需加载登录页与工作空间；代码回放按数组计算比例并缓存执行分布峰值，减少逐步播放时的重复计算。
improved.en: Load login and workspace pages on demand; calculate one scale per array and cache line-count peaks to reduce repeated work during replay.

improved.zh: 补充代码可视化权限矩阵和刷新异常回归，覆盖匿名请求、逐项授予和撤销权限、重复刷新、迟到响应及退出页面。
improved.en: Extend the permission matrix and history regression to cover anonymous access, individual grants and denials, repeated refresh, late responses and page exit.

notes.zh: 升级会自动新增公告已读记录表，保留账号、笔记、词书和学习进度。首次使用这项功能会显示当前版本公告；更新前保存编辑并保留备份，旧标签页刷新后使用新版。
notes.en: The upgrade adds a release receipt table while preserving accounts, notes, wordbooks and progress. On first use, the current release is announced. Save edits and keep a backup before updating; refresh older tabs to use the new version.
